title: feat(billing): introduce usage-based metering pipeline
description: Adds a metering pipeline that aggregates per-org usage events into billable line items, with a nightly rollup job, new tables, and an invoice preview API. Includes integration tests.
diff:
--- a/billing/metering/collector.py
+++ b/billing/metering/collector.py
@@
+class UsageCollector:
+    def __init__(self, store):
+        self.store = store
+    async def record(self, org_id, metric, qty, ts):
+        await self.store.append(UsageEvent(org_id, metric, qty, ts))
+    async def rollup(self, org_id, window):
+        events = await self.store.range(org_id, window)
+        return aggregate_by_metric(events)
--- a/billing/metering/invoice.py
+++ b/billing/metering/invoice.py
@@
+async def preview_invoice(org_id, period):
+    usage = await collector.rollup(org_id, period)
+    items = [LineItem(m, q, rate_for(m)) for m, q in usage.items()]
+    return Invoice(org_id, period, items, total=sum(i.amount for i in items))
--- a/billing/metering/jobs.py
+++ b/billing/metering/jobs.py
@@
+async def nightly_rollup():
+    for org in await orgs.all():
+        usage = await collector.rollup(org.id, yesterday())
+        await store.persist_rollup(org.id, usage)
--- a/migrations/0007_usage_events.sql
+++ b/migrations/0007_usage_events.sql
@@
+CREATE TABLE usage_events (
+  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
+  org_id UUID NOT NULL,

+  recorded_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL
+);
+CREATE TABLE usage_rollups (
+  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
+  org_id UUID NOT NULL,
+  period DATE NOT NULL,

+  total NUMERIC NOT NULL
+);
--- a/tests/test_metering.py
+++ b/tests/test_metering.py
@@
+async def test_rollup_aggregates_by_metric():
+    await collector.record(org, 'api_calls', 10, now())
+    await collector.record(org, 'api_calls', 5, now())
+    usage = await collector.rollup(org, today())

description: Adds an architecture note explaining team-derived management, scoped roles, and the visible_subjects predicate.
diff:
--- a/docs/rbac.md
+++ b/docs/rbac.md
@@
+# Authorization
+
+Authority is team-derived: a manager holds a `manager` role scoped to a team in
+`role_assignments`. There is no `manager_id` on users.
+
+## visible_subjects(viewer, scope)
+1. Different org -> DENY
+2. Subject is the viewer -> ALLOW (full)
+3. Viewer directly manages subject's team -> ALLOW (per-person)
+4. Otherwise -> AGGREGATE ONLY

title: fix(billing): reconcile double-charged subscriptions on retry
description: A retry path could charge a subscription twice when the first webhook was delayed. Adds an idempotency key, a reconciliation sweep, and refund issuance for confirmed duplicates. Includes tests.
diff:
--- a/billing/charges.py
+++ b/billing/charges.py
@@
-async def charge(sub):
-    return await gateway.charge(sub.customer, sub.amount)
+async def charge(sub, idempotency_key):
+    existing = await store.find_charge(idempotency_key)
+    if existing:
+        return existing
+    result = await gateway.charge(sub.customer, sub.amount, idempotency_key)
+    await store.record_charge(idempotency_key, result)
+    return result
--- a/billing/reconcile.py
+++ b/billing/reconcile.py
@@
+async def reconcile_duplicates(window):
+    charges = await store.charges_in(window)
+    for group in group_by_subscription(charges):
+        dupes = detect_duplicates(group)
+        for d in dupes:
+            await gateway.refund(d.id)
+            await store.mark_refunded(d.id)
--- a/tests/test_charges.py
+++ b/tests/test_charges.py
@@
+async def test_idempotent_charge_returns_existing():
+    a = await charge(sub, 'key-1')
+    b = await charge(sub, 'key-1')
+    assert a.id == b.id
+async def test_reconcile_refunds_duplicate():
+    await reconcile_duplicates(window)
+    assert gateway.refund.called
